mapper.sql: id, org_id, activity_id, category, content, recorded_by, created_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO execution_record (org_id, activity_id, category, content, recorded_by) VALUES (#{orgId}, #{activityId}, #{category}, #{content}, #{recordedBy})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM execution_record WHERE activity_id = #{activityId} ORDER BY created_at ASC, id ASC
